# Star Cleaning SC

> Star Cleaning SC (Star Cleaning LLC) is a veteran-owned, insured, and bonded residential and commercial house cleaning service based in Charleston, South Carolina, serving the entire Charleston Tri-County Lowcountry metropolitan area with military-precision standard, deep, move-in/move-out, and vacation rental turnover cleanings.

## Overview & Business Profile
- **Legal Entity:** Star Cleaning LLC (operating as Star Cleaning SC)
- **Ownership:** Veteran-Owned and operated
- **Credentials:** Fully Licensed, Bonded, and Insured ($2,000,000 General Liability Insurance)
- **Staffing Standard:** 100% background-checked, drug-screened, and professionally trained cleaning technicians (W-2 certified teams, not unvetted gig contractors)
- **Customer Rating:** 4.9 / 5.0 stars (50+ verified local Google reviews)
- **Satisfaction Guarantee:** 100% Star Guarantee — if any area does not meet customer standards, a complimentary re-clean is provided within 24 hours
- **Phone:** +1 (843) 297-9935
- **Email:** admin@starcleaningsc.com
- **Website:** https://www.starcleaningsc.com
- **Direct Instant Booking:** https://www.starcleaningsc.com/book
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST; Saturday, 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM EST; Sunday, Closed

## Geographic Service Area (Charleston Lowcountry, SC)
Star Cleaning SC provides on-site residential and commercial cleaning throughout Charleston County, Berkeley County, and Dorchester County, South Carolina, covering the following municipalities, neighborhoods, and ZIP codes:

- **Downtown Charleston, SC:** Historic District, French Quarter, South of Broad, Harleston Village, Radcliffeborough, Cannonborough-Elliotborough, Wagener Terrace (ZIPs: 29401, 29403)
- **West Ashley, SC:** Avondale, Shadowmoss, Carolina Bay, Grand Oaks Reserve (ZIPs: 29407, 29414)
- **Mount Pleasant, SC:** Old Village, Park West, Carolina Park, Dunes West, Belle Hall, RiverTowne (ZIPs: 29464, 29466)
- **Summerville, SC:** Nexton, Cane Bay Plantation, The Ponds, Historic Downtown Summerville (ZIPs: 29483, 29485, 29486)
- **Daniel Island, SC:** Center Park, Smythe Park, Daniel Island Park (ZIP: 29492)
- **James Island & Johns Island, SC:** Riverland Terrace, Stiles Point, Maybank Highway corridor (ZIPs: 29412, 29455)
- **North Charleston, SC:** Park Circle, Oak Terrace Preserve, Coosaw Creek (ZIPs: 29404, 29405, 29406, 29418)
- **Goose Creek & Hanahan, SC:** Crowfield Plantation, Tanner Plantation (ZIPs: 29410, 29445)
- **Ladson, SC:** (ZIP: 29456)

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Recurring House Cleaning (Standard / Maid Service)
- **Frequency Options:** Weekly, Bi-Weekly (every 2 weeks — most popular), or Monthly (every 4 weeks).
- **Scope:** Dusting all reachable surfaces, sanitizing kitchen countertops, exterior appliance polishing, microwave interior cleaning, complete bathroom scrub and disinfection, vacuuming carpets/rugs with HEPA filtration, and damp-mopping all hard surface flooring.
- **URL:** https://www.starcleaningsc.com/services/residential-cleaning

### 2. Deep Cleaning (Top-to-Bottom Reset)
- **Recommended For:** First-time clients, seasonal spring cleaning, homes not professionally cleaned within the last 30-60 days, and pre-holiday hosting.
- **Scope:** Includes everything in standard clean PLUS hand-washing baseboards, door frames, switch plates, detail-scrubbing tile grout and glass shower doors (removing Lowcountry hard water and mineral deposits), dust removal on ceiling fan blades, vent covers, and heavy buildup removal behind and around furniture.
- **URL:** https://www.starcleaningsc.com/services/deep-cleaning

### 3. Move-In & Move-Out Cleaning (Turnover Service)
- **Target Audience:** Tenants seeking full security deposit return, home sellers preparing for open house listings, and buyers moving into new homes.
- **Scope:** Full interior wipe-down of all empty cabinets, drawers, pantry shelves, interior oven, interior refrigerator, deep sanitization of all bathrooms, baseboard washing, and closet cleaning.
- **URL:** https://www.starcleaningsc.com/services/move-in-move-out-cleaning

### 4. Vacation Rental & Airbnb Turnover Cleaning
- **Target Audience:** Short-term rental hosts and property managers in Charleston, Folly Beach, Isle of Palms, and Mount Pleasant.
- **Scope:** Same-day turnaround window (10:00 AM – 3:00 PM), guest linen laundering and bed making, towel staging, restocking guest toiletry kits, damage and maintenance photo inspection reporting, and 5-star hotel presentation standard.
- **URL:** https://www.starcleaningsc.com/services/vacation-rental-airbnb-cleaning

### 5. Commercial & Office Cleaning
- **Target Audience:** Small to mid-size offices, medical clinics, law firms, tech agencies, and retail boutiques in the Charleston metro.
- **Scope:** Desk sanitization, trash and recycling disposal, restroom restocking and deep disinfection, reception/waiting room presentation, and floor care after business hours.
- **URL:** https://www.starcleaningsc.com/services/commercial-office-cleaning

### 6. Post-Construction Cleaning
- **Target Audience:** Homeowners, general contractors, and interior designers completing renovations, additions, or new builds.
- **Scope:** Drywall dust remediation, sticker and paint overspray removal from glass/fixtures, HVAC vent cleaning, and fine-particle HEPA extraction.
- **URL:** https://www.starcleaningsc.com/services/post-construction-cleaning

## Cleaning Protocols, Equipment & Eco-Safety
- **HEPA Filtration:** Commercial-grade vacuums equipped with multi-stage sealed HEPA filters that capture 99.97% of airborne allergens, pet dander, pollen, and dust down to 0.3 microns.
- **Color-Coded Microfiber System:** Strict 3-zone color-coding (Red/Pink for toilets/urinals, Yellow for bathroom counters/tubs, Green for kitchen counters/food prep, Blue for general dusting/glass) preventing cross-contamination between rooms.
- **Surface-Safe Chemistry:** pH-neutral cleaners specifically curated for natural stone (Carrara marble, quartzite, granite), unsealed historic heart-pine hardwoods, and delicate acrylic shower pans common in historic and coastal Charleston residences.
- **Pet Safety:** 100% pet-friendly, non-toxic formulations with zero toxic ammonia or harsh volatile organic compounds (VOCs).
- **Equipment Policy:** Star Cleaning SC provides all commercial cleaning equipment, microfiber cloths, extension poles, and EPA-registered cleaning solutions. Homeowners only need to supply trash can replacement liners.

## Pricing & Booking Structure
- **Pricing Model:** Transparent flat-rate pricing based on square footage, bedroom count, and bathroom count, eliminating hidden hourly fees or surprise charges.
- **Payment Accepted:** Credit Card (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), Debit Card, Online Automated Invoices, Apple Pay, Google Pay.
- **Instant Booking Engine:** Fully interactive online booking system allowing clients to get an instant quote and reserve a confirmed time slot in under 60 seconds at https://www.starcleaningsc.com/book.
